Nutrient Amendment - Inhibition Assay

Molly Kuhs

2026-11-08

Data Availability: Full dataset, code, and figures can be found here: https://github.com/makuhs/Inhibition-Phenotypes

Note: Included code creates base versions of all published figures. Additional elements such as legends, titles, and annotations were added via post-processing in Adobe Illustrator.

Packages

library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(stringr)
library(ragg)
library(emmeans)
library(ggpubr)
library(broom)
library(ape)
library(phylotools)
library(lmerTest)

Data

Load Data

fullData<- read.csv("pairwise_inhib_full.csv", header = T)

#str
fullData$Media <- as.factor(fullData$Media)
fullData$Zone_Radius <- as.numeric(fullData$Zone_Radius)

#area
dataArea <- fullData %>%
  mutate(area = pi*(Zone_Radius^2))

Main

Figure 1

1A: Intensity

dataZone <- dataArea %>%
  filter(area > 0)%>%
  group_by(Target, Overlay, Media, Treatment, Plot)%>%
  summarise(meanArea = mean(area))

dataZone[,4] <- ifelse(dataZone[,4] == "Non-Amended", "Low Nutrient History", 
                     ifelse(dataZone[,4] == "Amended", "High Nutrient History", 99))

dataZone$Media <- as.factor(dataZone$Media)
dataZone$Plot <- as.factor(dataZone$Plot)
dataZone$Treatment <- factor(dataZone$Treatment, levels = c("Low Nutrient History", "High Nutrient History"))

dataZoneSum <- dataZone %>%
  group_by(Treatment, Media)%>%
  summarize(mean = mean(meanArea),
         sd = sd(meanArea),
         n=n(),
         se=sd/sqrt(n),
         ci=se*qt((1-0.05)/2 + 0.5, n-1))

a1 <- dataZoneSum %>%
    filter(Media == 100)%>%
    ggplot(., aes(Treatment, mean, fill = Treatment))+
    geom_col(fill = c("#bbd6ed","#4a91ce"), alpha=0.8, width=0.75)+
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - se, ymax = mean + se), width = 0.1)+
    scale_x_discrete(labels = function(Treatment) str_wrap(Treatment, width = 15))+
    theme_minimal()+
    labs(x = "",
         y = expression(paste("Area of Inhibition Zone ", (mm^{2}))))

t.test(meanArea ~ Treatment, data = dataZone)
## 
##  Welch Two Sample t-test
## 
## data:  meanArea by Treatment
## t = 6.1655, df = 391.84, p-value = 1.749e-09
## alternative hypothesis: true difference in means between group Low Nutrient History and group High Nutrient History is not equal to 0
## 95 percent confidence interval:
##  107.5176 208.1889
## sample estimates:
##  mean in group Low Nutrient History mean in group High Nutrient History 
##                            540.7255                            382.8723

1B: Frequency

dataFreq <- dataArea %>%
  group_by(Plot, Media, Target, Overlay, Treatment)%>%
  summarise(mean = mean(area)) %>% 
  mutate(freq = case_when(mean > 0 ~ 1,
                          mean == 0 ~ 0))%>%
  ungroup()%>%
  group_by(Plot, Media, Target, Treatment)%>%
  summarise(count = n(),
            freq = sum(freq),
            perc = (freq/count)*100)

dataFreq[,4] <- ifelse(dataFreq[,4] == "Non-Amended", "Low Nutrient History", 
                       ifelse(dataFreq[,4] == "Amended", "High Nutrient History", 99))

dataFreq$Plot <- as.factor(dataFreq$Plot)
dataFreq$Treatment <- factor(dataFreq$Treatment, levels = c("Low Nutrient History", "High Nutrient History"))

dataFreq %>%
  filter(Media == 100)%>%
  t.test(perc ~ Treatment, data=.)
## 
##  Welch Two Sample t-test
## 
## data:  perc by Treatment
## t = -1.5347, df = 57.365, p-value = 0.1303
## alternative hypothesis: true difference in means between group Low Nutrient History and group High Nutrient History is not equal to 0
## 95 percent confidence interval:
##  -28.849905   3.812868
## sample estimates:
##  mean in group Low Nutrient History mean in group High Nutrient History 
##                            40.33333                            52.85185
dataFreqSum <- dataFreq %>%
  group_by(Treatment, Media)%>%
  summarize(mean = mean(perc),
            sd = sd(perc),
            n=n(),
            se=sd/sqrt(n),
            ci=se*qt((1-0.05)/2 + 0.5, n-1))

b1<- dataFreqSum %>%
  filter(Media == 100)%>%
  ggplot(., aes(Treatment, mean))+
  geom_col(aes(fill = Treatment), alpha=0.8, width=0.75)+
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - se, ymax = mean + se), width = 0.1)+
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off",
                  ylim = c(0, 95))+
  scale_x_discrete(labels = function(Treatment) str_wrap(Treatment, width = 15))+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#bbd6ed","#4a91ce"))+
  theme_minimal()+
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  labs(x = "",
       y = ("Percent of Inhibited Sympatric Isolates (%)"))

1C: Freq by Intensity

# data prep
meanDataZone <- dataZone %>%
  group_by(Target, Treatment, Media)%>%
  summarise(meanZone = mean(meanArea))

freqInt <- merge(meanDataZone, dataFreq, by = c("Target", "Treatment", "Media"))%>%
  mutate(block = case_when(
    Plot == 1 | Plot == 2 ~ "Block 1",
    Plot == 3 | Plot == 4 ~ "Block 2",
    Plot == 5 | Plot == 6 ~ "Block 3"
  ))

# linear model
d1 <- freqInt %>% filter(Media == 100)
m1 <- lm(meanZone ~ perc * Treatment, data = d1)

emtrends(m1, ~ Treatment, var = "perc") %>%
  summary(infer = TRUE)
##  Treatment             perc.trend   SE df lower.CL upper.CL t.ratio p.value
##  Low Nutrient History        3.69 1.36 44    0.941     6.43   2.706  0.0097
##  High Nutrient History       2.77 1.52 44   -0.286     5.83   1.827  0.0746
## 
## Confidence level used: 0.95
# figure
c1 <- freqInt %>%
  filter(Media == 100)%>%
ggplot(., aes(perc,meanZone, color = Treatment))+
  geom_smooth(method="lm", se=F,
              show.legend = F)+
  geom_point(alpha=0.75)+
  theme_minimal()+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#bbd6ed","#4a91ce"),
                     name = "")+
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 900))+
  theme(legend.position = "none")+
  labs(
    x= "\nMean Inhibition Frequency",
    y= "Mean Inhibition Intensity\n"
  )

Final

finalfig1 <- ggarrange(
  ggarrange(a1, b1, ncol = 2),
  c1,
  nrow = 2,
  heights = c(2, 2))

finalfig1

Figure 2:

2A: Intensity by plot

# Inhibition zone by plot: 
blockDataZone <- dataZone %>%
  mutate(block = case_when(
    Plot == 1| Plot == 2 ~ "A",
    Plot == 3| Plot == 4 ~ "B",
    Plot == 5| Plot == 6 ~ "C"))

d <- blockDataZone %>%
  filter(Media == 100) %>%
  mutate(block = factor(block),
         Plot = factor(Plot),
         Treatment = factor(Treatment),
         Target = factor(Target))  

pm_raw <- d %>%
  group_by(block, Treatment, Target) %>%
  summarise(y = mean(meanArea), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(block, Treatment) %>%
  summarise(m = mean(y), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Treatment, values_from = m)

# block-level 
pm_raw

t.test(pm_raw$`High Nutrient History`,

Figure 3:

Responsiveness Calculation

dataDiff <- dataArea %>% 
  group_by(Plot, Media, Target, Overlay, Treatment)%>%
  summarise(mean = mean(area))%>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Media, values_from = mean)%>%
  rename(
    media10 = "10",
    media100 = "100")%>%
  ungroup()%>%
  mutate(diff = media100 - media10,
         absDiff = abs(diff))

sd <- sd(dataDiff$absDiff)

dataDiff <- dataDiff %>%
  mutate(group = case_when(
           media100 > media10 & media10 != 0 & absDiff > sd ~ "increase",
           media10 > media100 & media100 != 0 & absDiff > sd ~ "decrease",
           media100 == 0 & media10 != 0 ~ "suppression",
           media10 == 0 & media100 != 0 ~ "induction",
           media10 != 0 & media100 != 0 & absDiff < sd ~ "no change",
           media10 == 0 & media100 == 0 ~ "no inhibition"
         ))

dataDiff[,4] <- ifelse(dataDiff[,4] == "Non-Amended", "Low Nutrient History", 
                          ifelse(dataDiff[,4] == "Amended", "High Nutrient History", 99))

dataDiff$Treatment <- factor(dataDiff$Treatment, levels = c("High Nutrient History", "Low Nutrient History"))
dataDiff$group <- factor(dataDiff$group, levels = c("induction", "increase", "decrease", "suppression", "no change", "no inhibition"))

#summary 
dataDiffSum<- dataDiff%>%
  group_by(Treatment, group)%>%
  summarise(count = n())%>%
  ungroup()%>%
  group_by(Treatment)%>%
  mutate(total = sum(count),
         freq = count/total)

dataDiffSum$Treatment <- factor(dataDiffSum$Treatment, levels = c("Low Nutrient History", "High Nutrient History"))

dataDiffSum$group <- factor(dataDiffSum$group, levels = c("suppression", "decrease", "no change", "increase", "induction"))

3A: Responsiveness Intensity

a3 <- dataDiffSum %>%
filter(group != "no inhibition")%>%
ggplot(., aes(group, freq, fill=group))+
  geom_col(position = "dodge", alpha=0.8)+
  facet_wrap(~Treatment)+
  scale_fill_manual(values= c("#EA725D", "#F5BB62", "grey90", "#85d1d1", "#5499c7"),
                    name = "")+
  theme_minimal()+
  theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "none",
        plot.margin = margin(0.5, 1, 0.5, 0.75, "cm"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7, angle = 45, vjust = 1.2, hjust=1))+
  labs(x = "",
       y = "Frequency of Responsivness (%)\n")

3B: Responsiveness Intensity

b3 <- dataDiff %>%
  filter(group != "no inhibition")%>%
  ggplot(., aes(diff, Treatment))+
  geom_vline(xintercept=0, color = "grey60", lty = 2)+
  geom_point(aes(color = group),
             position = position_jitter(height = 0.2, width =0), 
             alpha=0.75,
             size = 1.2)+
  geom_boxplot(fill = NA, width = 0.2, outlier.shape = NA)+
  scale_color_manual(values= c("#5499C7", "#aed6d6","#f5c67f","#db7c6b","grey88"),
                    name = "")+
  theme_minimal()+
  theme(legend.position = "none", 
        axis.text.y = element_blank())+
  labs(x = "Responsivness Intensity", y = "")

Figure 4:

Nutrient Use Data

#### Niche Width ####
nw <- read.csv("e001nicheWidthTest.csv")%>%
  filter(Plot_x == Plot_y)%>%
  select(-Treatment_x)%>%
  select(-Treatment_y)%>%
  select(-Plot_y)%>%
  rename(Plot = Plot_x,
         Target = Isolate_x,
         Overlay = Isolate_y)

# area
dataAreaNW <- merge(dataArea, nw, by=c("Plot", "Overlay", "Target"))%>%
  group_by(Plot, Media, Target, Overlay, Treatment, overlap_pw, overlap_hv)%>%
  summarise(mean = mean(area))%>%
  ungroup()

dataAreaNW[,5] <- ifelse(dataAreaNW[,5] == "Non-Amended", "Low Nutrient History", 
                    ifelse(dataAreaNW[,5] == "Amended", "High Nutrient History", 99))

dataAreaNW[,2] <- ifelse(dataAreaNW[,2] == "10", "Low Resource Environment", 
                         ifelse(dataAreaNW[,2] == "100", "High Resource Environment", 99))

dataAreaNW$Treatment <- factor(dataAreaNW$Treatment, levels = c("Low Nutrient History", "High Nutrient History"))

dataAreaNW$Media <- factor(dataAreaNW$Media, levels = c("Low Resource Environment", "High Resource Environment"))

Figure 4: Responsiveness by Niche Overlap

dataAreaNW %>%
  filter(mean > 0)%>%
  ggplot(., aes(overlap_hv, mean, color = Media))+
  geom_point(alpha=0.5, size = 0.8)+
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = F, size = 0.8)+
  facet_wrap(~Treatment, scales = "free")+
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0.28, 1.0),
                  ylim = c(0, 1650))+
  theme_minimal()+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#5499C7", "#e68270"), name = "")+
  theme(panel.spacing = unit(1.2, "lines"),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 6.5),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 6.5),
        legend.position = "none")+
  labs(x = "Niche Overlap", 
       y = "Inhibition Intensity")

Supplement

Table S1: Soil Data

#soil data
soilData <- read.csv("SoilChemData.csv")

# By Treatment 
soilData %>%
  group_by(Treatment)%>%
  summarise(pH = mean(pH),
            BrayP = mean(Bray.P),
            K = mean(K),
            totalC = mean(Total.C),
            NO3N = mean(NO3.N))
## # A tibble: 2 × 6
##   Treatment      pH BrayP     K totalC  NO3N
##   <chr>       <dbl> <dbl> <dbl>  <dbl> <dbl>
## 1 Amended      6.08  159.  167   0.981  3.39
## 2 Non-Amended  6.3   147.  153.  0.731  1.54
soilData %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(pH, Bray.P, K, Total.C, NO3.N),
    names_to = "Chemical",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  group_by(Chemical) %>%
  summarise(
    tidy(t.test(Value ~ Treatment)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
## # A tibble: 5 × 11
##   Chemical estimate estimate1 estimate2 statistic p.value parameter  conf.low
##   <chr>       <dbl>     <dbl>     <dbl>     <dbl>   <dbl>     <dbl>     <dbl>
## 1 Bray.P     12.1     159.      147.         1.13  0.278       12.4 -11.1    
## 2 K          14.3     167       153.         1.21  0.243       15.8 -10.8    
## 3 NO3.N       1.84      3.39      1.54       2.87  0.0120      14.5   0.470  
## 4 Total.C     0.25      0.981     0.731      2.10  0.0556      13.5  -0.00687
## 5 pH         -0.222     6.08      6.3       -1.80  0.0939      13.6  -0.488  
## # ℹ 3 more variables: conf.high <dbl>, method <chr>, alternative <chr>
# By Plot 
soilData %>%
  group_by(LabPlot_ID)%>%
  summarise(pH = mean(pH),
            BrayP = mean(Bray.P),
            K = mean(K),
            totalC = mean(Total.C),

dataZoneFullSum <- dataZoneFull %>%

  summarize(mean = mean(meanArea),
            sd = sd(meanArea),
            n=n(),

s2a <- dataZoneFullSum %>%

t.test(meanArea ~ Treatment, data = dataZoneFull)
## 
##  Welch Two Sample t-test
## 
## data:  meanArea by Treatment
## t = 1.4133, df = 1125, p-value = 0.1579
## alternative hypothesis: true difference in means between group Low Nutrient History and group High Nutrient History is not equal to 0
## 95 percent confidence interval:
##  -9.047991 55.646584
## sample estimates:
##  mean in group Low Nutrient History mean in group High Nutrient History

#by plot 

# Inhibition zone by plot: 
blockDataZoneFull <- dataZoneFull %>%
  mutate(block = case_when(
    Plot == 1| Plot == 2 ~ "A",
    Plot == 3| Plot == 4 ~ "B",
    Plot == 5| Plot == 6 ~ "C"))

dFull <- blockDataZoneFull %>%
  filter(Media == 100) %>%
  mutate(block = factor(block),
         Plot = factor(Plot),
         Treatment = factor(Treatment),
         Target = factor(Target))  

pm_full <- dFull %>%
  group_by(block, Treatment, Target) %>%
  summarise(y = mean(meanArea), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(block, Treatment) %>%
  summarise(m = mean(y), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Treatment, values_from = m)

# Paired t-test 
t.test(pm_full$`High Nutrient History`,
             pm_full$`Low Nutrient History`, paired = TRUE)
## 
##  Paired t-test
##

#figure
IntensityFull <- dataZoneFull %>%
  mutate(lab = case_when(
    Plot == 1 ~ "LN 1",
    Plot == 2 ~ "HN 1",
    Plot == 3 ~ "LN 2",
    Plot == 4 ~ "HN 2",
    Plot == 5 ~ "LN 3",
    Plot == 6 ~ "HN 3"))%>%
  filter(Media == 100)

s2b <- ggplot(IntensityFull, aes(reorder(lab, as.numeric(Plot)), meanArea, color = Treatment, fill = Treatment))+
  geom_boxplot(alpha=0.5, outlier.shape = NA)+
  geom_point(position=position_jitter(width=0.3), 
             size = 1, alpha=0.8)+
  geom_vline(xintercept = 2.5,
             color = "grey80", lty = 2)+
  geom_vline(xintercept = 4.5,
             color = "grey80", lty = 2)+
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off",
                  y=c(0,1400))+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#bbd6ed","#4a91ce"))+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#bbd6ed","#4a91ce"))+
  theme_minimal()+
  theme(legend.position = "none")+
  labs(x = "",
       y = expression(paste("Area of Inhibition Zone ", (mm^{2}))))

Fig S3: Inhibition by Frequency (by plot)

freqInt %>%
  filter(Media == 100)%>%
  ggplot(., aes(perc,meanZone, color = Treatment))+
  geom_smooth(method="lm", se=F, size = 0.8,
              show.legend = F)+
  geom_point(alpha=0.75)+
  theme_minimal()+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#bbd6ed","#4a91ce"),
                     name = "")+
  #scale_shape_manual(values = c(15, 16, 17, 15, 16, 17))+
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 900))+
  theme(legend.position = "none")+
  facet_wrap(~block, nrow = 3)+
  labs(
    x= "\nMean Inhibition Frequency",
    y= "Mean Inhibition Intensity\n"
  )

individual_lm <- freqInt %>%
  filter(Media == 100) %>%
  group_by(block, Treatment) %>%
  nest() %>%
  mutate(
    model = map(data, ~ lm(meanZone ~ perc, data = .x)),
    coefficients = map(model, tidy),
    fit = map(model, glance))

# Slopes, intercepts, and p-values
individual_lm %>%
  select(block, Treatment, coefficients) %>%
  unnest(coefficients)

d1 <- freqInt %>%
  filter(Media == 100)

m2 <- lmer(
  meanZone ~ perc * Treatment + (1 | block),
  data = d1
)

summary(m2)
